subject: Kickoff ground ops — deviation windows, ride recovery & credentialing
messages:
From: Hector Salazar <hector@driveplus.net>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@oakridgecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite kickoff — draft pickup windows and staging

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Attached is our first pass at curb staging and pickup windows for the Jun 28 kickoff day. Core notes: 24 vehicles (mix of sedans and SUVs) in two staging lanes, 15-minute pickup windows, and a 30-minute deviation buffer for late arrivals. See attached 'pickup-windows.pdf'.

Two items to flag immediately:
- We recommend a 6-car rental buffer (weekday rate) to act as ride-recovery if a car breaks or a surge hits.
- We need a CSV with driver credential matches for site security — a quick export will work (name, license last 4, vehicle plate).

If you want, we can also pre-book a local car-service standby (higher rate) for the executive arrival window 08:30–10:30.

Attachments: [pickup-windows.pdf (PDF)]

Best,
Hector
DrivePlus Logistics
ops@driveplus.net
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Hector Salazar <hector@driveplus.net>, Silverline Limo <ops@silverlinelimo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite kickoff — draft pickup windows and staging

Thanks, Hector — solid start. A couple of clarifying asks before we lock: 

1) Ride-recovery policy: can you price the 6-car rental buffer as a contingency cost line (flat hold + per-day), and separately the standby car-service hourly uplift? We need both numbers to decide which we guarantee.

2) Credentialing: we'll provide driver name/plate details, but security requires a two-step: (a) pre-approve list 48 hrs prior and (b) badge pickup at staging with printed manifest. Can you incorporate a manifest handoff at the valet table and confirm that drivers will accept manifest checks?

3) Curb windows: 15-min windows are fine but please add a 10-min grace for AV load/unload for the east driveway.

Action: Marissa, can you confirm headcount and VIP list by EOD so Hector can size vehicles? Rishi/Naomi — please confirm if finance will cover a rental contingency or if that comes out of the event budget.

On the attachments: please save the driver-credentials.csv template that Hector requested; I'll share the completed file once Marissa confirms names.

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Events & Field Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Hector Salazar <hector@driveplus.net>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite kickoff — draft pickup windows and staging

Dylan — confirming tentative headcount: 78 attendees, 6 execs (VIP), 12 instructors. I can deliver the VIP list by close of business today.

Quick note: two VIPs need ADA-accessible sedans and one has a mobility aid — please include that in the vehicle mix. I approve the 6-car rental buffer as an initial hold; we'll firm up funding after Rishi's call.

Marissa
Senior Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference
From: Silverline Limo <ops@silverlinelimo.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite kickoff — draft pickup windows and staging

Hi team,

Thanks for the details. We attached a sample driver-credentials.csv (blank template) and a rental-block confirmation PDF showing the 6-car hold at local vendor 'CityCar Rentals' (rate and cancel terms included).

Answers:
- Rental buffer: hold cost = $120/day per vehicle (waived if used), cancellation up to 48 hrs with no fee. Detailed line in rental-block-confirmation.pdf.
- Standby car-service: $65/hr per vehicle minimum 4 hrs; we recommend holding 2 standby sedans for the exec window.
- Manifest handoff: drivers will accept printed manifests; Silverline will staff a marshal at the valet table to cross-check license last-4 and plate.
- ADA: confirmed accessible vehicles and trained drivers are on the roster.

Attachments: [driver-credentials.csv (CSV), rental-block-confirmation.pdf (PDF)]

Let us know if you want us to spin up the DocuSign for the rental hold.

— Ops team, Silverline
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Silverline Limo <ops@silverlinelimo.com>, Hector Salazar <hector@driveplus.net>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite kickoff — draft pickup windows and staging

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps: 

- Marissa: please send VIP list and ADA notes by Mon 06/21 12:00 PST.
- Rishi: please confirm by EOD Mon whether finance will approve the $120/day rental contingency or if events should absorb the cost; if finance approves, ops to proceed with the DocuSign hold referenced below.
- Silverline/Hector: please go ahead and create the DocuSign for the rental hold (we'll sign once finance confirms). Also add the 10-min AV grace to the east driveway windows.
- Naomi: please accept manifest handoff SOP below and add to the site access packet.

Manifest handoff SOP (for the packet): printed manifest at valet table; marshal checks driver license last-4 + plate; drivers not on manifest are diverted to overflow staging and asked for event contact.

Related links: planning doc in Drive (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdDrivePlan) — I updated the flow for arrival-to-lobby. Once Rishi confirms funding we'll sign rental hold: https://app.docusign.com/doc/XYZ123

I'll follow up once the VIP list lands.

Thanks,
Dylan
Events & Field Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
